stories.title: ‘Breaking Bad’ actor RJ Mitte dead at 34
stories.summary: Breaking Bad actor and disability rights advocate RJ Mitte , died Monday at the age of 34, authorities and his representatives said. Cameron County Justice of the Peace Cyndi Hinojosa told The Associated Press she declared Mitte dead at about 1:30 p.m.

stories.title: Puravankara Q2 sales bookings surge 62% to Rs 2,136 crore on housing demand
stories.summary: In the September quarter, Puravankara Ltd reported a remarkable surge in sales bookings, hitting Rs 2,136 crore, a jump from Rs 1,322 crore a year earlier. With the sales area expanding by 22 percent to 1.83 million square feet, the company also successfully delivered 977 homes, which amount to 0.97 million square feet.

stories.summary: That's up from its July forecast for three per cent growth and well below the 3.5 per cent expansion in 2025. stories.title: PTC Industries among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 15% in a month
stories.summary: Amid the market rally, four stocks from the BSE 500 index touched fresh 52-week highs, reaching their highest levels in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous 12 months and can indicate increased investor interest and trading activity.

stories.title: The best financial advice is often to do nothing, says Value Research CEO Dhirendra Kumar
stories.summary: Value Research CEO Dhirendra Kumar says good financial advice often means helping investors avoid unnecessary transactions and impulsive decisions. Speaking at the Global Financial Planners Summit Team 2026, he stressed the importance of financial education at home, disciplined investing and understanding products before making decisions with long-term financial consequences.

stories.title: IMF raises India growth forecast to 7% as oil shock, AI reshape global outlook
stories.summary: But what's powering the economy — and what could slow it down?In its October 2026 World Economic Outlook, the International Monetary Fund points to resilient domestic demand and strong services activity as key drivers of India's growth. The forecast puts India ahead of global growth, projected at 3.1% in 2026 and 3.4% in 2027.But there are risks.

stories.title: Strong statistical systems key to achieving Viksit Bharat by 2047, says PM's principal secretary
stories.summary: India requires a reliable and technology-enabled statistical system to aid evidence-based policymaking. Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister P K Mishra emphasized the need for stronger state-level statistical institutions.

stories.title: India's benchmark bond breaks 4-day falling streak as value investors return
stories.summary: The benchmark bond yield has risen due to a central bank policy rate hike and liquidity measures. Germany’s 10-year government bond yields, the euro area benchmark, were down 2 basis points (bps) to 3.47%.

stories.title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
stories.summary: Amex said it has not yet seen an increase in disputes because of agentic commerce, but it wanted to be proactive in building this technology as this type of commerce scales. consumers said they’re likely to use AI agents to research the best price for a product or service, and 61% said they’re likely to use it for a product or service recommendation over the next 12 months, the company told TechCrunch.

stories.title: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Q2 results: Profit jumps 50% YoY to Rs 42 crore, revenue rises 20%
stories.summary: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers reported a 50% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 41.93 crore in Q2FY27, while revenue from operations grew 20.25% to Rs 273.21 crore. Growth was supported by higher MTF interest income, distribution revenue and continued client acquisition amid market volatility.

stories.title: Market wrap: HCL Tech, TCS, Kotak Bank, Eternal top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
stories.summary: Indian equity markets rallied over 1.5% on Tuesday, with the Sensex rising 1,109 points and the Nifty 50 gaining 358 points. IT stocks led the advance, with HCL Tech and TCS topping the gainers’ lists.

stories.title: Tata Elxsi Q2 Results: Profit rises 10% YoY to Rs 170 crore; revenue grows 15%
stories.summary: Tata Elxsi reported a 10% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 170 crore in Q2, while revenue from operations grew 15% to Rs 1,056 crore. Higher employee and operating expenses, along with lower other income, weighed on margins.

stories.title: US stocks: Goldman Sachs quarterly profit rises on equities strength
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs reported a remarkable profit increase in the third quarter, largely thanks to fluctuating market dynamics. Equities revenue soared by 72%, amounting to $6.44 billion, even as fixed income revenue saw a minor dip.

stories.title: US stocks: Citi profit jumps 40% with higher investment banking, services and wealth revenue
stories.summary: Citigroup has reported a remarkable 40% jump in its third-quarter profits year-over-year, despite some declines in other areas. Trading revenue took a hit, influenced by unstable market conditions, while investment banking saw a modest 9% year-on-year increase but fell substantially from the last quarter.

stories.title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
stories.summary: Only five years into its journey, Character.AI, which lets users create AI characters and have conversations with them, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, following a slew of lawsuits and struggles to scale its popular platform.

stories.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US market seesaw as chip stocks weigh; bank results shape sentiment
stories.summary: Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: US stocks trade lower on Tuesday as chip shares come under renewed selling pressure, while investors assess mixed quarterly results, including earnings from major US banks. Meanwhile, JPMorgan Chase’s profit falls short of analysts’ estimates, although the banking giant points to continued strength in technology investment and consumer spending.

stories.title: Global Market: European shares rise as lower oil prices lift sentiment; tech stocks slide
stories.summary: European markets saw an uptick, driven by declining oil prices that buoyed sentiment across numerous sectors. Investors geared up for critical economic data from Germany, as they hope for clearer insights into the regional economy.

stories.title: PM GatiShakti: over 400 infra projects worth Rs 20.23 lakh cr recommended for approval
stories.summary: Over 400 infrastructure projects worth approximately Rs 20.23 lakh crore have been approved under the PM GatiShakti initiative. The Network Planning Group reviewed these projects for investments exceeding Rs 500 crore.

stories.title: Stellantis CEO says they can learn from Chinese partners — shows EV confidence
stories.summary: Antonio Filosa, CEO of Stellantis, and Jiangming Zhu, Founder, Chairman of the Board and CEO of Leapmotor, attend a press conference on media day at the 2026 Paris Auto Show in Paris, France, Oct. "I do not fully agree with the view that ​we are missing key capabilities, but there are certainly areas where we can complement each other," Filosa said.

stories.title: Scindia calls for faster tailored credit flow to Northeastern states at bankers' conclave
stories.summary: During a recent gathering at Mizoram University, Union minister Jyotiraditya Scindia urged financial institutions to provide credit solutions that address the specific needs of the Northeast region. Mizoram Chief Minister Lalduhoma shared initiatives requiring investment, hinting at potential economic drivers for the area that could facilitate sustained growth and enhance public welfare.

stories.title: IMF's bullish call: Why is India sprinting when the world stumbles?
stories.summary: The IMF has raised India's growth forecast to 7% for both FY27 and FY28, highlighting the country's resilience despite higher oil prices and a slowing global economy. India races ahead as the global economy slows, with the IMF projecting 7% growth.

stories.title: Bayer’s DirectAcres crosses 2,00,000 acres in India
stories.summary: Bayer brings together its capabilities in Seeds & Traits, Crop Protection, Digital Farming Solutions and agronomy with tailored mechanization and digital advisory to support farmers through the transition. ​The initiative has grown from 3,500 hectares in 2023 to over 81,000 hectares in 2026.

stories.title: Rupee volatility in focus as Sitharaman signals more RBI action, weighs LTCG tax debate
stories.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said the RBI may take further measures to curb rupee volatility, clarifying that its aim is to stabilise the currency rather than fix its value. The rupee has hit a low, and the RBI is making significant efforts through regulatory measures to keep it stable, said Sitharaman, said FM Nirmala Sitharaman.

stories.title: PM GatiShakti completes 5 years, next phase focuses on multimodal connectivity: Piyush Goyal
stories.summary: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal on Tuesday said the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan would continue to support multimodal connectivity, faster infrastructure development and greater logistics efficiency as the initiative completed five years.

stories.title: This Punjabi rapper was murdered in 2022. His new tour is testing the market for holographic concerts
stories.summary: Sidhu Moose Wala's Signed to God world tour kicked off in Toronto last Friday, with a hologram standing in on stage for the Punjabi rap star who was shot and killed in 2022. Punjabi rapper Sidhu Moose Wala was shot to death in 2022 in northern India.

stories.title: Ottawa wants to expand the oilsands, but the industry's wastewater problem will grow with it
stories.summary: Yet, ever since the first oilsands mine was built about 60 years ago, the industry has been banned from releasing any water. Tailings ponds are at capacity and no one wants more of the storage lakes built, said Alberta's Environment Minister Grant Hunter, in an interview with CBC News in Fort McMurray.

stories.title: The Andaman Islands could be India's next big trade trump card
stories.summary: India is focusing on strengthening the Andaman and Nicobar Islands' strategic maritime role for regional trade. The upcoming Andaman Dialogue 2027 will emphasize maritime infrastructure and economic cooperation among countries in the Indo-Pacific region.

stories.title: SBI Research calls for abolition of LTCG tax on equities to boost foreign capital inflows
stories.summary: According to SBI Research, removing the long-term capital gains tax on equities could revitalize investment levels. SBI Research has proposed scrapping the long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax on equities and extending the holding period to two to three years to boost capital inflows and investor sentiment amid sustained FPI outflows.

stories.title: India, America expanding cooperation across sectors: US ambassador Sergio Gor
stories.summary: Kolkata and the United States are strengthening ties across sectors such as defence, IT, and healthcare. Recent military exercises involving 500 troops and significant investments showcase this growing partnership.

stories.title: Blackstone COO flags tech disruption, geopolitical conflicts as global risks; says India's investment climate improving
stories.summary: He stressed India's progress in infrastructure and foreign investment, which enhance growth prospects. Blackstone President and COO Jonathan Gray said technology-driven disruption, geopolitical conflicts and rising government debt pose key risks to the global economy, while improving infrastructure and investment conditions are bolstering India’s growth prospects.

stories.title: PM Modi's free trade push could lead to $140 billion GDP gain for India
stories.summary: A more protectionist US could unexpectedly benefit India as New Delhi expands its free-trade agreements (FTAs) to diversify export markets and attract investment. A World Trade Organization-based model estimates that India’s concluded and proposed trade deals, including agreements with the EU and New Zealand, could add about $140 billion to GDP by 2035, lifting it 1.7% above the baseline.

stories.title: IMF raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
stories.summary: The International Monetary Fund has increased India's economic growth projections for FY27 and FY28 to 7%. India's GDP growth reached 7.8% in FY26, exceeding expectations during the April-June quarter.
